final: WITH project_counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS n FROM project_counts), shares AS (SELECT p.arcref, p.record_count, CAST(p.record_count AS REAL) / t.n AS share FROM project_counts AS p CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.n IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.arcref, s.record_count, s.share, s.share - m.value FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m WHERE m.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.share - m.value DESC LIMIT 10
